correctness.rationale: The source defines simultaneous grafting only for finite sets of sprouts, while Proposition 12.3 grafts the set of all n-petals up to ordinary isomorphism. With Sigma={p_bullet}, a stable one-cluster canonical tree can be arranged at a reflexive canonical bud representative Psi. For every m>=1, the m-point reflexive modal cluster mapped constantly to Psi is a canonical Sigma-tree in the same region, is graftable, and has strict height and width zero. Thus these are pairwise nonisomorphic 3-petals and the all-petals set is infinite. The argument targets the displayed construction only.
